_contract.membersCount: Counted-noun chip for `<group> · <n> members`. Keyed by CLDR plural category — resolve with new Intl.PluralRules(lang).select(n) and fall back to `other`. NEVER reuse row.members after a numeral: it is a table-row LABEL, not a counted noun, and languages with case/classifier/tamyiz agreement (ru, th, ar) break when it is.
_contract.typeVal: Localized value map for the roster `type`/`gender` enum, so a localized table never prints the raw English data value. Sub-key names and strings are copied verbatim from modules/seo-kpop-agency-l10n.js so the agency, vs and lightstick clusters say the same word. Pick: type==='group' ? (gender==='girl' ? girl : gender==='boy' ? boy : group) : soloist.
